Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class KristenHttpServer

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Server
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.KristenHttpServer
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, Runnable
    public class KristenHttpServer
extends Server
    Provides a KDC server for receiving and processing agents using the HTTP protocol.

    The server creates a default HTTP context using the path configured by KristenHttpServerParameters. Additional contexts may be created using createContext(String).

    Received agents are deserialized and dispatched to the APIs configured for the server.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    Server, KristenHttpServerParameters, KristenHttpClient

    • Constructor Detail

      • KristenHttpServer

        public KristenHttpServer​(KristenHttpServerParameters parameters)
                  throws com.kristensoft.kdc.license.runtime.LicenseException,
                         KristenCommsException
        Creates an HTTP server using the specified parameters.

        The server is started automatically if automatic startup is enabled in the supplied parameters.

        Parameters:
        parameters - the parameters used to configure the HTTP server
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if parameters is null
        com.kristensoft.kdc.license.runtime.LicenseException - if the server cannot be created due to a licensing error
        KristenCommsException - if a KDC communications error occurs
        See Also:
        KristenHttpServerParameters

      • start

        public void start()
        Starts this HTTP server.

        Creates the underlying HTTP server, configures its request executor and default context, and begins accepting HTTP requests. If the server is already started, this method returns without taking further action.

        Overrides:
        start in class Server

      • clear

        public void clear()
        Removes all pending requests from the HTTP server request queue.

      • stop

        public void stop​(int delay)
        Stops this HTTP server.

        The specified delay allows current HTTP exchanges time to complete before the underlying server is stopped. If the server is not started, this method returns without taking further action.

        Parameters:
        delay - the maximum time, in seconds, to wait for current exchanges to complete
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if delay is less than zero
        IllegalStateException - if the underlying HTTP server is not available

      • createContext

        public com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpContext createContext​(String path)
        Creates an HTTP context for the specified path.

        Returns:
